mechanics.claim: The bola stops and deals damage/stun only upon hitting an enemy champion; if it travels far enough first it becomes empowered.
mechanics.quote: throws an ice bola in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} them

mechanics.claim: Empowered detonation deals the increased damage separately from the initial hit and creates a frost storm.
mechanics.quote: gaining increased damage and stun duration. The detonation creates a frost storm

mechanics.claim: The storm shatters after a delay dealing the increased damage again to all enemies within, as a separate area damage instance.
mechanics.quote: After a brief moment, the storm shatters to deal {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|slow}} enemies within

mechanics.claim: The primary target hit by the bola does not take the storm's damage/slow.
mechanics.quote: The enemy hit by the bola is unaffected by the storm's effects.

mechanics.claim: The bola applies spell damage to the primary target but area damage to secondary targets caught in the storm.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets in the ice storm.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks only one instance of this ability's damage (primary hit or storm, not both).
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} will block only a single instance of damage.
